---
title: "The RBA’s 50th Anniversary Symposium"
date: "2010-02-09"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Monetary Policy"]
---

Today I attended the RBA’s 50th anniversary symposium.  The proceedings were not for attribution, but the [papers](http://www.rba.gov.au/publications/confs/2010/index.html "papers") have been published on the RBA’s web site.  The session on supply-side issues was a particularly welcome contribution to an area too often neglected by central banks, but one that is inescapably linked to the conduct of monetary policy.
